correctness.rationale: From the exact odd-index telescoping sum u(2m+1)=1+2 sum_{k=1}^m u(k), parity of oddpart mod4 yields a finite A(m) recurrence. Binary induction establishes u(2^v(2m+1))=1+2 eps0+4Q(m) mod8 for all m,v. Two-state transfer T=[[1,1],[-1,1]] satisfies T^T T=2I and T^4=-4I, deriving both rational generating functions and exact dyadic counts. Aligned dyadic blocks yield O(sqrt N), and N=2^(4a+1) yields matching lower-size fluctuations separately for each residue. Independent exact recurrence/mod8 test checked 65,535 terms and all 16 dyadic prefix censuses to 2^16; infinite claim is analytic.
